summary: No dedicated helicopter landing site at EGVN; aerodrome is a notified parachute drop zone up to 15,000 ft.
text:
NO DEDICATED HELICOPTER LANDING SITE. ROTARY USERS REQUIRE PPR 
THROUGH THE A5 PROCESS. AIRFIELD OPS WILL ALLOCATE A LANDING OR 
PARKING LOCATION. HELICOPTERS SHOULD NORMALLY USE THE MAIN RUNWAY 
AND GROUND TAXI TO OR FROM DISPERSAL. AERODROME IS A NOTIFIED 
PARACHUTE/FREE-FALL DROP ZONE TO 15000FT. LIGHT AIRCRAFT FLYING CLUB 
OPERATES DAILY WITH VISUAL CIRCUIT HEIGHT 1300FT QNH.
